lastCompletedStory.title: Remediate a failed verify with a bare submit key on the idle path and emit push-recovered

nextStoryContext: sendBareSubmitKey is exported from src/tmux/dispatch.ts with signature (paneId, tmuxSpawnFn) and sends exactly `send-keys -t <paneId> Enter` through tmuxArgs, with no payload text and no -l. The idle path now calls it after each failed non-terminal verify, emits push-recovered only when a later verify succeeds, and preserves a single payload-bearing send. US-003 can reuse this helper verbatim on the pane-not-idle path. Real cat fixtures echo bare submits as blank lines, so shallow-pane assertions that must retain the original payload should inspect capture-pane scrollback.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current tmux documentation confirms send-keys recognizes Enter as a key, while -l disables key-name lookup and would send the literal text instead.
